parameters.query:
SELECT $1::UUID AS organization_id, $2::UUID AS thread_id, $3::TEXT AS process_id,
       $4::TEXT AS user_message, $5::JSONB AS history,
       jsonb_build_object(
         'organization', jsonb_build_object('name', organization.name, 'legal_name', organization.legal_name,
           'tax_id', organization.tax_id, 'city', organization.city, 'department', organization.department,
           'organization_type', organization.organization_type),
         'capability_profile', COALESCE((
           SELECT jsonb_build_object('summary', profile.company_summary, 'products_services', profile.products_services,
             'unspsc_codes', profile.unspsc_codes, 'service_departments', profile.service_departments,
             'certifications', profile.certifications, 'years_experience', profile.years_experience)
           FROM saas.organization_capability_profiles profile
           WHERE profile.organization_id = organization.id AND profile.is_active = TRUE
           ORDER BY profile.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
         ), '{}'::JSONB),
         'documents', COALESCE((
           SELECT jsonb_agg(document_row.payload) FROM (
             SELECT jsonb_build_object('name', document.document_name, 'type', document.document_type,
               'issue_date', document.issue_date, 'expiration_date', document.expiration_date,
               'verification_status', document.verification_status,
               'text_excerpt', LEFT(COALESCE(document.extracted_text, ''), 1200)) AS payload
             FROM saas.organization_documents document
             WHERE document.organization_id = organization.id AND document.document_status <> 'deleted'
             ORDER BY document.updated_at DESC LIMIT 15
           ) document_row
         ), '[]'::JSONB),
         'opportunity', COALESCE((
           SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', process.id, 'reference', process.reference, 'name', process.process_name,
             'entity', process.entity_name, 'department', process.department, 'city', process.city,
             'base_price', process.base_price, 'response_deadline', process.response_deadline, 'url', process.process_url)
           FROM secop.processes process
           WHERE process.id = NULLIF($3, '')::UUID AND EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM saas.process_matches match WHERE match.organization_id = organization.id AND match.process_id = process.id
           )
         ), 'null'::JSONB)
       ) AS authorized_context
FROM saas.organizations organization
WHERE organization.id = $1::UUID;
